symbols.name: cyai.documentation.documentation_url
symbols.description: Build an encoded file URL to the bundled manual. Unknown pages return to Start here. No network request or WebView is started.

parameters.name: page_id
parameters.description: Stable page ID or a configured alias.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Requested locale; unsupported languages use English.

parameters.name: anchor
parameters.description: Explicit heading or media anchor. Invalid anchors raise ValueError.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Optional media state, including the media ID. Unknown media IDs are rejected.

parameters.name: theme
parameters.description: Host theme; dark maps to the midnight reader theme.

symbols.returns: An absolute file URL to Documentation/Documentation.html with an encoded fragment.

symbols.name: cyai.documentation.canonical_route
symbols.description: Validate a route against the bundled manifest. Resolve aliases, normalize locale, and reject invalid explicit anchors and media IDs.

parameters.name: page_id
parameters.description: Stable page ID or a configured alias.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Requested locale; unsupported languages use English.

parameters.name: anchor
parameters.description: Explicit heading or media anchor. Invalid anchors raise ValueError.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Optional media state, including the media ID. Unknown media IDs are rejected.

parameters.name: theme
parameters.description: Host theme; dark maps to the midnight reader theme.

symbols.returns: A dictionary containing pageId, locale, anchor, state and normalized theme.
